actors.name: Malicious Plant Operator / Exporter
actors.motivation: Underreport CO2 or Specific Embedded Emissions to evade CBAM certificate liabilities or 10-30% punitive default markups

actors.name: Dishonest / Lazy Verifier Node
actors.motivation: Collect verification fees without executing compute-intensive AI/physics checks, or rubber-stamp falsified operator data

actors.name: Corrupted Verifier Quorum Majority (>=3 nodes)
actors.motivation: Extort plant operators via fraudulent quarantine flags or censor valid batches
capabilities: 3-of-5 threshold voting control in VerifierQuorum contract

actors.name: Network Eavesdropper / MitM
actors.motivation: Intercept proprietary industrial production telemetry or inject altered payload packets in transit
capabilities: Off-chain packet sniffing and interception between edge gateway and verifiers

actors.name: Hostile Third Party / Gas Spammer
actors.motivation: Disrupt protocol liveness, stall finality, or exhaust contract gas limits
capabilities: EVM public mempool spamming and reentrant transaction crafting

actors.name: Coordinated Plant Insider
actors.motivation: Falsify emissions while evading cross-source consistency checks against fuel and electricity meters
capabilities: Simultaneous write access to CEMS historians, fuel pipeline delivery meters, and plant accounting books

trust_assumptions.name: Cryptographic Primitives
trust_assumptions.description: NIST P-256 ECDSA and SHA-256 provide 128-bit security margin against forgery and preimage attacks.

trust_assumptions.name: Hardware Isolation
trust_assumptions.description: Prototype software secure element models production hardware Secure Element (e.g. ATECC608/TPM) preventing key export.

trust_assumptions.name: Verifier Independence
trust_assumptions.description: At least 3 out of 5 verifiers operate independently without collusion or common organizational ownership.

trust_assumptions.name: Multisig Arbiter Integrity
trust_assumptions.description: The 2-of-3 arbiter council honestly reviews raw evidence during an overturned dispute.

trust_assumptions.name: L2 Network Liveness
trust_assumptions.description: EVM Layer-2 sequencer processes transactions within commit (1h) and challenge (24h) timeframes.

attacks.name: Digital Tampering
attacks.description: Post-signing tampering with sensor readings, sequence numbers, or timestamps in transit or off-chain database.
attacks.control: RFC 8785 canonical JSON + ECDSA P-256 signature verification over SHA-256 packet hash + SHA-256 hash chaining (prev_hash).
attacks.remaining_weakness: Signatures prove origin, not ground truth. Key compromise allows signing arbitrary falsified values.

attacks.name: Replay & Sequence Tampering
attacks.description: Deleting high-emission records, duplicating low-emission records, reordering readings, or replaying historical telemetry batches.
attacks.control: Monotonic sequence numbers (seq), non-decreasing UTC timestamps, unbroken prev_hash chaining, and on-chain contiguous range enforcement in BatchAnchor.anchorBatch.
attacks.remaining_weakness: An attacker with signing key could synthesize a continuous replacement sequence from scratch; requires AI/physics models to catch duplicate operating profiles.

attacks.name: Physical / Analog Tampering
attacks.description: Introducing dilution air into smokestack sampling line, probe misalignment, or sensor bypass.
attacks.control: Out of scope for software edge prototype. Partially addressed off-chain by mass-balance stoichiometry checks on stack oxygen and flue gas temperature (PHYSICS_RESIDUAL, AE_RESIDUAL).
attacks.test_evidence: benchmark_summary.json scenarios 1A-7A, schemas/channels.json synthetic channel annotations
attacks.remaining_weakness: Sensor faithfully reporting an adulterated sample stream. Tampering without stoichiometry violation requires physical CEMS tamper seals.

attacks.name: Coordinated Insider Fraud
attacks.description: Simultaneous co-falsification of smokestack CEMS readings and primary fuel delivery accounting records.
attacks.control: Cross-source consistency checks (CROSS_SOURCE_MISMATCH) comparing continuous CEMS telemetry against independent utility fuel meters and power grid gross load.
attacks.test_evidence: Adaptive Attacker 8A (100.00% recall via fuel mismatch) vs 8B (0.0% recall when fuel ledger is co-falsified)
attacks.remaining_weakness: When an insider co-falsifies all correlated plant systems simultaneously below the noise floor, detection collapses to 0.0% recall.

attacks.name: Gateway Firmware Compromise
attacks.description: Compromised edge gateway operating system injecting fake readings before cryptographic hashing and signing.
attacks.control: Secure Element memory isolation; DeviceRegistry.sol on-chain revocation and key rotation; bonded operator financial liability in BondVault.sol.
attacks.remaining_weakness: Prototype emulates secure element in software. Production requires remote hardware attestation (e.g. TPM/DICE quotes).

attacks.name: Verifier Collusion & Free-Riding
attacks.description: Lazy verifiers copying revealed votes without inference, or verifiers colluding to extort operators or pass fraudulent data.
attacks.control: 3-of-5 threshold commit-reveal quorum in VerifierQuorum.sol; required verifier stake; unrevealed verifier slash (unrevealedPenaltyBps); careless verifier slash (carelessVerifierSlashBps) upon arbiter dispute overturn.
attacks.remaining_weakness: If >= 3 verifiers collude off-chain, they control the quorum. Requires diverse institutional verifiers in production.

attacks.name: Challenge Griefing
attacks.description: Operator filing repetitive frivolous disputes to stall attestation finality, or attacker freezing operator bond.
attacks.control: Time-bounded challenge window (windowClosesAt); disputes require Merkle leaf inclusion proof; 2-of-3 Arbiter council resolution; automated settlement of expired challenges (settleExpired).
attacks.remaining_weakness: Arbiter council introduces a trusted human bottleneck that can delay CBAM quarterly settlement.

attacks.name: Vote Front-Running
attacks.description: Verifiers spying on public mempool to duplicate peer votes and evade compute costs.
attacks.control: Two-phase Commit-Reveal scheme: commitment hash keccak256(batchId, modelHash, inputHash, scoreBp, verdict, salt) submitted in Phase 1; reveals rejected before commitEnd; verified in Phase 2.
attacks.remaining_weakness: Withholding attack: verifier commits but refuses to reveal, risking penalty but potentially stalling tight quorum.

attacks.name: Gateway / Operator Key Compromise
attacks.description: Attacker steals private signing key to forge stack emissions data remotely.
attacks.control: Immediate key revocation and rotation in DeviceRegistry.sol; 7-day withdrawal lock on operator stake bonds in BondVault.sol prevents capital flight during forensic investigation.
attacks.remaining_weakness: Batches anchored prior to on-chain key revocation must be caught by verifier physics/ML models or disputed in an active challenge window.

attacks.name: Gas Griefing & Liveness Exhaustion
attacks.description: Attacker attempts to exhaust contract gas or trigger unbounded loop execution to halt settlements.
attacks.control: Off-chain raw data storage (only 32-byte roots on-chain); loops strictly bounded by MAX_VERIFIERS = 5; pull-payment withdrawals in BondVault; nonReentrant guards on state-mutating payouts and finalization.
attacks.remaining_weakness: L2 sequencer downtime or extreme network gas spikes can delay batch anchoring or commit/reveal transactions within deadline windows.
